caveats.en: No Arm64 build. Test deployment first: installing the 32-bit edition on Arm needed a fix as recently as August 2026.
caveats.zh-TW: 沒有 Arm64 版本。部署前請先測試：32 位元版在 Arm 上的安裝問題，2026 年 8 月才有修正紀錄。

evidence.title: Adobe: app compatibility on Copilot+ PCs

caveats.en: x64 plug-ins do not load. MKV import and some hardware-accelerated exports are still missing.
caveats.zh-TW: x64 外掛無法載入，MKV 匯入和部分硬體加速匯出仍未支援。

caveats.en: Only the beta runs on Arm. A community expert says the beta has since gone native, but Adobe hasn't confirmed this.
caveats.zh-TW: Arm 上只有 Beta 版可用。社群專家稱 Beta 已改為原生，但 Adobe 尚未證實。

evidence.title: Adobe: app compatibility on Copilot+ PCs

caveats.en: Beta only. Adobe's stated minimum requirements name Snapdragon only.
caveats.zh-TW: 僅限 Beta 版，Adobe 的最低需求只列 Snapdragon。

evidence.title: Adobe: InDesign support for Windows on Arm

caveats.en: Adobe's pages disagree: its compatibility page says native, while another requirements page lists only Intel and AMD.
caveats.zh-TW: Adobe 的頁面說法不一：相容性頁面標示原生，另一份系統需求頁只列 Intel 與 AMD。

evidence.title: Adobe: app compatibility on Copilot+ PCs

caveats.en: RTX Spark support is in the beta release at launch.
caveats.zh-TW: RTX Spark 支援在上市時僅限 Beta 版。

caveats.en: Adobe's last published feature-gap list on Arm dates from 2022, so current gaps are unconfirmed.
caveats.zh-TW: Adobe 上次公布 Arm 功能缺口是 2022 年，目前缺口尚未確認。

evidence.title: NVIDIA: RTX Spark PCs available today

caveats.en: RTX Spark support is in the beta release.
caveats.zh-TW: RTX Spark 支援在 Beta 版。

caveats.en: x64 plug-ins do not load. MKV and several RAW video formats are still missing.
caveats.zh-TW: x64 外掛無法載入，MKV 和多種 RAW 影片格式仍未支援。

caveats.en: Arc now receives Chromium updates only, and its maker recommends moving to Dia.
caveats.zh-TW: Arc 現在只接收 Chromium 更新，開發商建議改用 Dia。

caveats.en: Autodesk says Arm devices are not officially supported, even if the program installs and starts.
caveats.zh-TW: Autodesk 表示 Arm 裝置不受官方支援，即使能安裝和啟動。

caveats.en: Result comes from one catalog, not a test on RTX Spark.
caveats.zh-TW: 結果只來自單一資料庫，並非在 RTX Spark 實測。

caveats.zh-TW: Autodesk 表示 Arm 裝置不受官方支援，即使能安裝和啟動。

caveats.en: Autodesk says Arm devices are not officially supported, even if the program installs and starts.
caveats.zh-TW: Autodesk 表示 Arm 裝置不受官方支援，即使能安裝和啟動。

caveats.en: Plug-ins and GPU features are unverified.
caveats.zh-TW: 外掛和 GPU 功能尚未驗證。

caveats.en: Doesn't launch in testing. NVIDIA expects EA Javelin anti-cheat support in early 2027.
caveats.zh-TW: 實測無法啟動。NVIDIA 預計 EA Javelin 反作弊系統在 2027 年初支援。

caveats.en: GPU rendering with OptiX was tested on the 5.3 beta. Sources disagree about GPU support in stable versions.
caveats.zh-TW: OptiX GPU 算圖是以 5.3 Beta 實測，各來源對穩定版的 GPU 支援說法不一。

evidence.title: XDA: Blender scene rendered on RTX Spark

caveats.en: Only the installer architecture was confirmed. GPU acceleration and effects are untested.
caveats.zh-TW: 只確認了安裝檔架構，GPU 加速和特效尚未驗證。

caveats.en: Applies to the portable nvidia_arm64 build. Comfy Desktop is listed as emulated. Custom nodes with x64 DLLs do not load.
caveats.zh-TW: 適用於可攜式 nvidia_arm64 版本。Comfy Desktop 被列為模擬執行，含 x64 DLL 的自訂節點無法載入。

caveats.en: Requires RTX Spark driver 616.41 or later.
caveats.zh-TW: 需要 RTX Spark 驅動程式 616.41 以上。

evidence.title: NVIDIA: getting started with RTX Spark development

caveats.en: Runs well at 1440p with frame generation, but ray tracing is demanding. PC Gamer measured an average of 36 fps at 1080p RT Ultra.
caveats.zh-TW: 1440p 開啟畫格生成時運作良好，但光線追蹤較吃力。PC Gamer 測得 1080p RT Ultra 平均 36 fps。

caveats.en: Requires NVIDIA Studio Driver 616.0 or later, according to a third party quoting the official readme. CUDA acceleration has no test report yet.
caveats.zh-TW: 需要 NVIDIA Studio Driver 616.0 以上，這是第三方轉述官方說明。CUDA 加速尚無實測。

evidence.title: DaVinci Resolve Club: Windows x86 vs Arm

caveats.en: Where you install from matters: winget and the Microsoft Store list x64 only, and those installs run under Prism.
caveats.zh-TW: 安裝來源會決定架構：winget 和 Microsoft Store 只有 x64，這些安裝會透過 Prism 執行。

caveats.en: Windows on Arm support is in Early Access and requires the WSL 2 backend. CUDA inside containers has no official confirmation.
caveats.zh-TW: Windows on Arm 支援為 Early Access，只能使用 WSL 2 後端。容器內的 CUDA 尚無官方確認。

caveats.en: Doesn't launch in testing. EA Javelin anti-cheat is the suspected cause, not confirmed.
caveats.zh-TW: 實測無法啟動。推測原因是 EA Javelin 反作弊系統，但尚未證實。

caveats.en: Easy Anti-Cheat runs natively, but the game itself is emulated.
caveats.zh-TW: Easy Anti-Cheat 是原生執行，但遊戲本身是模擬執行。

evidence.title: XDA: two decades of Windows games on RTX Spark

caveats.en: NVIDIA says it's playable. No independent test has been found.
caveats.zh-TW: NVIDIA 稱可以遊玩，但未找到獨立實測。

caveats.en: NVENC on RTX Spark is unverified.
caveats.zh-TW: RTX Spark 上的 NVENC 尚未驗證。

caveats.en: NVIDIA confirms RTX Spark support but doesn't state the architecture. Installer issues have been reported.
caveats.zh-TW: NVIDIA 確認支援 RTX Spark，但未說明架構，也有安裝問題的回報。

evidence.title: NVIDIA: RTX Spark PCs available today

caveats.en: The official page confirms IntelliJ IDEA only. Other IDEs rely on catalog records.
caveats.zh-TW: 官方頁面只確認 IntelliJ IDEA，其他 IDE 依據資料庫記錄。

caveats.en: Vanguard support is listed as coming after launch, so treat this as not supported yet. No test of the failure itself was found.
caveats.zh-TW: Vanguard 支援列為上市後推出，應視為尚未支援。未找到實際失敗的測試紀錄。

caveats.en: Ships a win-cuda-13.4-arm64 build. A performance regression on arm64 and Blackwell is being tracked upstream.
caveats.zh-TW: 提供 win-cuda-13.4-arm64 版本。上游仍在追蹤 arm64 與 Blackwell 的效能回歸問題。

caveats.en: Documentation names Snapdragon only. Don't assume GPU acceleration on RTX Spark.
caveats.zh-TW: 文件只提到 Snapdragon，不要預設 RTX Spark 有 GPU 加速。

evidence.title: XDA: two decades of Windows games on RTX Spark

caveats.en: Officially supported through Prism. Simulink Desktop Real-Time, TensorFlow, QEMU, and third-party hardware interfaces are not.
caveats.zh-TW: 透過 Prism 獲官方支援，但不支援 Simulink Desktop Real-Time、TensorFlow、QEMU 和第三方硬體介面。

evidence.title: MathWorks: MATLAB on Windows on Arm
Surface Pro on Arm app management

caveats.en: Support for 32-bit Microsoft 365 on Arm ends in December 2026. Perpetual versions such as Office 2021 need the 32-bit edition.
caveats.zh-TW: Arm 版 32 位元 Microsoft 365 的安全更新於 2026 年 12 月結束。Office 2021 等買斷版需安裝 32 位元版。

caveats.en: Test older add-ins and macros separately.
caveats.zh-TW: 舊版增益集和巨集需另外測試。

caveats.en: Support for 32-bit Microsoft 365 on Arm ends in December 2026. Perpetual versions such as Office 2021 need the 32-bit edition.
caveats.zh-TW: Arm 版 32 位元 Microsoft 365 的安全更新於 2026 年 12 月結束。Office 2021 等買斷版需安裝 32 位元版。

caveats.en: Support for 32-bit Microsoft 365 on Arm ends in December 2026. Perpetual versions such as Office 2021 need the 32-bit edition.
caveats.zh-TW: Arm 版 32 位元 Microsoft 365 的安全更新於 2026 年 12 月結束。Office 2021 等買斷版需安裝 32 位元版。

caveats.en: Native npm add-ons need a win32-arm64 build from each package.
caveats.zh-TW: 原生 npm 附加元件需要各套件提供 win32-arm64 版本。

caveats.en: Requires Windows on Arm driver 617.42 or later.
caveats.zh-TW: 需要 Windows on Arm 驅動程式 617.42 以上。

caveats.en: GitHub offers the Arm64 build as a zip only. x64 plug-ins do not load. NVENC is enabled on Arm64, but nobody has confirmed it on RTX Spark yet.
caveats.zh-TW: GitHub 上的 Arm64 版只有 zip，x64 外掛無法載入。NVENC 已在 Arm64 啟用，但尚未在 RTX Spark 確認。

caveats.en: A ProArt P16 user reports Gateway restart problems under WSL 2.
caveats.zh-TW: 有 ProArt P16 使用者回報 WSL 2 下的 Gateway 重啟問題。

caveats.en: Opera GX is a separate product, and one catalog lists it as emulated.
caveats.zh-TW: Opera GX 是獨立產品，有資料庫將它列為模擬執行。

caveats.en: x64 extensions do not load. NVIDIA reports support for 97% of the top 15,000 packages. Some, such as cryptography, grpcio, PyArrow, and OpenCV, may need compiling.
caveats.zh-TW: x64 擴充模組無法載入。NVIDIA 稱支援前 15,000 大套件的 97%，cryptography、grpcio、PyArrow、OpenCV 等可能要自行編譯。

caveats.en: The CUDA build comes from NVIDIA's package index and not from pytorch.org. Follow NVIDIA's guide exactly, and check CUDA again after installing other packages, which can replace torch.
caveats.zh-TW: CUDA 版來自 NVIDIA 的套件索引，不是 pytorch.org。請完全依照 NVIDIA 指南安裝。安裝其他套件可能會換掉 torch，裝完後要再確認 CUDA。

evidence.title: NVIDIA: getting started with RTX Spark development

caveats.en: SketchUp says running x64 under emulation on Arm64 in a virtual machine is not supported. Running does not mean officially supported.
caveats.zh-TW: SketchUp 表示在 Arm64 虛擬機器中模擬 x64 不受支援，能執行不代表有官方支援。

caveats.en: Result comes from one catalog, not a test on RTX Spark.
caveats.zh-TW: 結果只來自單一資料庫，並非在 RTX Spark 實測。

caveats.en: No official support statement was found.
caveats.zh-TW: 未找到官方支援聲明。

caveats.en: The client runs under Prism. Whether a game runs depends on the game and its anti-cheat.
caveats.zh-TW: 用戶端透過 Prism 執行。遊戲能否執行要看遊戲本身和反作弊系統。

caveats.en: The blocker is the Vanguard anti-cheat, not Prism. Riot says support is coming without giving a date.
caveats.zh-TW: 阻擋的是 Vanguard 反作弊系統，而不是 Prism。Riot 表示會支援，但沒有給日期。

caveats.en: Windows 11 only. Remove older versions before installing.
caveats.zh-TW: 僅支援 Windows 11，安裝前請移除舊版。

caveats.en: Extensions with x64 native modules may not load.
caveats.zh-TW: 含 x64 原生模組的擴充功能可能無法載入。

caveats.en: The vendor labels this build Windows ARM64 (Snapdragon) and doesn't name RTX Spark.
caveats.zh-TW: 原廠標示為 Windows ARM64 (Snapdragon)，未提到 RTX Spark。

caveats.en: Unofficial preview. Supports only the 128GB machine with Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP4-Local. Performance numbers are the author's own.
caveats.zh-TW: 非官方預覽版，只支援 128GB 機種搭配 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP4-Local。效能數字是作者自測。

caveats.en: Unofficial beta for Python 3.14, CUDA 13.4, and PyTorch 2.14. Needs a manual source edit and self-compiled dependencies. The upstream vLLM project has no official Windows Arm64 wheel.
caveats.zh-TW: 非官方 Beta 版，需要 Python 3.14、CUDA 13.4、PyTorch 2.14，還要手動修改原始碼並自行編譯相依套件。上游 vLLM 沒有官方 Windows Arm64 wheel。

caveats.en: CUDA inside WSL 2 has only community evidence so far.
caveats.zh-TW: WSL 2 內的 CUDA 目前只有社群證據。
